At \(Z=(0,300)\), check the vertex optimality condition. The weighted sum of unit directions from \(Z\) to the other towns is

\[
S=100(0,-1)+200\frac{(200,-300)}{\sqrt{200^2+300^2}}
=\left(\frac{400}{\sqrt{13}},\ -100-\frac{600}{\sqrt{13}}\right).
\]

Then

\[
\|S\|^2=50000+\frac{120000}{\sqrt{13}}<90000=300^2.
\]

So \(\|S\|<300\), meaning \(Z=(0,300)\) is the unique minimizer. Thus

\[
x+y=0+300=300.
\]

\[
\boxed{300}
\]
